title: Two helpers in one loop
idea: TOOL. Apply and combine two helpers on each item inside one loop.

exercises.prompt: You can call more than one helper on the same item inside a loop.
exercises.explanation: Each item can be handed to several helpers.

exercises.prompt: Arrange: for each item print double plus triple.

Combine two helpers on the item:

print(double(n) + ____(n))

(second helper is add1)
exercises.explanation: double(n) + add1(n) for the current item.

exercises.prompt: REVIEW (composing): double(add1(n)) for n=2 gives... (add1 then double)
Using two helpers per item still keeps each call's variables private.
exercises.explanation: Scope holds — every call is independent.

options: A loop can call several helpers per item
You must use only one helper ever
Build a richer result from small single-job pieces
exercises.explanation: Small pieces, combined — the composing habit inside a loop.

options: A loop can apply and combine several helpers on each item
exercises.explanation: Several single-job helpers, combined per item.
